system.description:
You encircle yourself and other willing creatures in range with potent Wind Release Chakra. For the duration, you magnify the targets physical capabilities with the following.

Affected creatures gain a Rank of mastery to their Strength or Dexterity Saving throws (Pick one) and their movement speed is increased by +10 feet.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can select both Abilities to gain a rank of mastery for their saves. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank its duration becomes 1 minute, losing the need to concentration on it.
